note: How to read a histogram. X axis is brightness 0 (black) to 255 (white); Y axis is the number of pixels. The shadows/midtones/highlights split is thirds of the axis; the image only shows the labels, the exact boundaries are an assumption.

items.name: Shadows
items.description: Left third of the histogram (about 0-85). Dark areas; crushed if the graph piles up at the very left edge.
items.prompt: deep shadows, rich dark tones with retained detail, lifted blacks

items.name: Midtones
items.description: Middle of the histogram (about 85-170). Most of the picture's information: skin and general scene brightness.
items.prompt: balanced midtones, natural skin tones, neutral exposure

items.name: Highlights
items.description: Right third (about 170-255). Bright areas; clipped if the graph piles up at the right edge.
items.prompt: bright highlights with retained detail, soft highlight roll-off, no clipping

items.name: Tonal range
items.description: The span between the darkest and brightest pixels. A wide span means the full tonal range is used.
items.prompt: full tonal range from deep blacks to bright whites

items.name: Properly exposed
items.description: Bell-shaped graph centred in the middle, tapering to both edges without touching them.
items.prompt: well exposed, balanced histogram, detail in shadows and highlights

items.name: Underexposed
items.description: Graph bunched against the left edge. Image is too dark; shadow detail is lost.
items.prompt: underexposed dark image, crushed shadows, low-key gloom

items.name: Overexposed
items.description: Graph bunched against the right edge. Image is too bright; highlights are blown.
items.prompt: overexposed bright image, blown-out highlights, washed-out high-key look

items.name: Low contrast
items.description: A narrow spike in the middle with empty ends. Flat, hazy image with little separation between tones.
items.prompt: low contrast flat look, muted tones, hazy soft grade

items.name: High contrast
items.description: Two heavy peaks at the far left and far right with a gap in the middle. Strong darks and brights with little between.
items.prompt: high contrast punchy grade, deep blacks and bright whites, dramatic look
